notes.PMW3360_gated: steady mode: on only while an IMU pre-detector sees a candidate tremor line, for the 20 s calibration and for confirmation windows (duty 10-30 %, ASSUMPTION); needs EXP-L01 to show the IMU pre-detector misses no tremor line the page detector finds
notes.PMW3610_class: 0.60 mA typ at 1.8 V (MFR OPT-61), x1.5 for its polling and the regulator (ASSUMPTION); 3200 cpi (7.9 um counts), 24-30 in/s, 10 g: enough for the detector, slip and capture; whether it gives autowrite's 1 kHz / 2 ms / 10 um on paper is unknown (EXP-J10)

page_options.label: CALC (MFR AMF-109, OPT-61; gating duty ASSUMPTION)

page_needs.steady: tremor-line detector (Welch spectrum of the last 4 s every 50 ms on a 250 Hz grid, 4.5-13.5 Hz band, amplitude gate 0.15-0.35 mm); the listening smoother (the IMU carries the estimate: 421 vs 412 um with the page sensor, SIM ai2 s4.7); the ink log for the app
page_needs.guide: handle position on the page for the template (>= 120 Hz, <= 10 ms: CHECKPOINT s7), heel slip
page_needs.lead: position and heel slip (study D), >= 120 Hz
page_needs.autowrite: 1 kHz, <= 2 ms, <= 10 um (DEC-036, REQ-RVJ-N06; 120 Hz doubles the ink error, SIM study N)
